int dist[MAXN][MAXN];
bool pos[MAXN][MAXN];

            if (0 <= u.first && u.first < n && 0 <= u.second && u.second < n && a[u.first][u.second] != 'Y' && d + 1 < bum[u.first][u.second])

            ii u = ii(v.first + dy[i], v.second + dx[i]);

                dist[u.first][u.second] = d + 1, q.push(u);
